27 years of clinical excellence in acne care. Acne is not just a cosmetic nuisance — it's a chronic medical condition with deep physical and emotional consequences, from painful cysts to lingering scars.

At Rajkot's leading acne clinic, backed by 27 years of clinical excellence, we specialize in transforming lives through evidence-based dermatology.
